gaps.quote: Outside a set $B$ of exceptional addresses, $S_0$ agrees with the exact map $T_0$ that performs the XORs.
gaps.note: The page never says which cyclic shifts make up S_0 (only that their number is constant and that a shift adds an offset set by the other chunks), nor why the composition agrees with T_0 off B. The claim is not marked as cited, so the reader cannot check it from the page.
